description: Election Commission - Code of Conduct - Parliament Election
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively concerns electoral processes, specifically the Code of Conduct for political parties, independent groups, and candidates during elections. It outlines rules and regulations governing election campaigning, propaganda activities, and general conduct for all participants in the electoral process, as issued under the Parliamentary Elections Act. This falls squarely under the "Elections Gazettes" category (Type 7) which covers electoral regulations, candidate conduct, and election-related procedures.
